items.description: Liranga is a river town in Likouala in northern Congo. Its life and trade are closely tied to the Congo River system.
Lukolela is a small river settlement in northern Congo. It belongs to the Congo Basin's wetland and river network.
Tchikapika is a town in Cuvette in north-central Congo. It serves as a local stop for travel and rural exchange.
Kayes is a town in south-western Congo. It has a local role in trade and rural settlement life.
Mabombo is a town in south-western Congo. It is part of the Bouenza area and supports nearby farming communities.
Londela-Kayes is a small town in south-western Congo. It is a local community stop rather than a major urban center.
Kimongo is a town in Niari in south-western Congo. It lies in a borderland region and serves nearby rural areas.
Mayoko is a town in Niari in south-western Congo. It is known for mining activity and its link to the Congo-Ocean Railway.
Banda is a small town in south-western Congo. It has a quiet rural profile and a local role in the surrounding area.
Divénié is a town in Niari in south-western Congo. It supports nearby agricultural activity and local movement between settlements.
